title: Not a fan -- not up to Farberware quality standards ...
text:
Not a fan -- not up to Farberware quality standards .... Wow -- these all-purpose shears are just not that good. What happened to Farberware quality? I've been a huge fan of their kitchen products for years, but these are really in a class by themselves -- and not a good one. The construction is flimsy, so I'm reluctant to use them for anything but the lightest duty. The self-sharpening sheath, while a good idea, fails in execution. All it does is place more stress on the pivot joint connecting the blades which seems fragile to start with.

Farberware is going to have to do better than this. I can't recommend these. Sorry.

product_metadata.title: Farberware 5171959 High Carbon Stainless Steel Bent Shears with EdgeKeeper Self-Sharpening Sheath and Contoured Handles, Black
features: STAINLESS STEEL BLADE: These bent shears feature high carbon stainless steel blades that has an offset blade design that is ideal for cutting flat items like paper, crafts and fabrics.
COMFORT GRIP HANDLES: The shears feature an ergonomically designed handle for comfort during use
EASY TO CLEAN: Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent - rinse and dry immediately; shears are not dishwasher safe.
description: Farberware Edgekeeper Bent Shears with Built-in Sharpening sleeve is an ideal and convenient way to keep your shears at their optimum sharpness at all times. Featuring high-carbon stainless steel blades. These multipurpose shears are perfect for everyday flat cutting tasks. The built-in sharpener in the protective sleeve allows you to sharpen the blades at any time. By simply placing the bottom blade through the sharpener then closing the blades together, both the bottom and top blades are sharpened in one motion! The sleeve also protects the blades when not in use and provides safe, secure storage. Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse and dry immediately. Do not put in the dishwasher.
